answer_1.quote: In summary, our work introduces RecipeNLG - the novel dataset of cooking recipes, along with the language generation task based on this dataset.
answer_1.outputs: The model was given a set of food entities and ordered to generate full recipes.

answer_2.quote: We used cosine similarity calculated upon TF-IDF representation to measure the similarity of a generated recipe and its gold standard counterpart... We used the LanguageCheck spell and grammar checker to calculate the amount of linguistic mistakes... We used three common ones: BLEU, GLEU, and WER (Word Error Rate).
